dependencies: polyself.c:1121-1154 dropp() is the existing helper boundary: it scans gi.invent before calling dropx(); js/polyself.js:697-715 supplies dropx() with newsym, encumber_msg, and remove_object hooks. Its void result is discarded by break_armor().

polyself.c:1259-1271 calls Shield_off(), Helmet_off(), and dropp(); do_wear.c:518-756 defines the return-0 takeoff callbacks. Existing js/do_wear.js _doWearInternals has Shield_off() (1914-1923) and Helmet_off() (1786-1814), but their supported-type guards must not refuse valid polymorph removal branches.

polyself.c:1273-1285 calls Boots_off() for nohands, verysmall, slithy, or centaur forms; do_wear.c:262-323 defines the return-0 callback and js/do_wear.js:1358-1461 is its existing owner. polyself.c:1210-1219 similarly requires Cloak_off(); js/do_wear.js:1612-1631 owns it with currently limited cloak types.

The breakarm body branch at polyself.c:1162-1197 requires end_burn(), Armor_gone(), Cloak_off(), and useup(); Armor_gone() is do_wear.c:938-974 and has no exported JS owner in the accepted commit. The headless branch at polyself.c:1287-1300 requires Blindf_off(NULL), whose do_wear.c:1495-1534 result is discarded and is not exposed through _doWearInternals.

Return-valued predicates used by break_armor are existing owners: racial_exception() is used as <1 at polyself.c:1199 and is implemented in js/makemon_create.js:2686-2718; WrappingAllowed() gates mummy wrapping at polyself.c:1176-1178 and :1210-1212 and is implemented in js/obj.js:1347-1358. breakarm(), sliparm(), has_horns(), nohands(), verysmall(), slithy(), is_whirly(), and has_head() are existing mondata/property predicates. No direct return-valued missing callee is needed beyond these existing owners; the missing takeoff callbacks are impure side-effect dependencies despite discarded C return values.

Downstream polyself.c:1953-1969 skinback() still needs its artifact-light radius capture and maybe_adjust_light() update when merged dragon scales are restored; js/polyself.js:679-690 retains that known gap separately from break_armor.
